comments.content: The `time` type sets `$columnData['time'] = []`, but verify the corresponding column output logic actually handles a `time` key (e.g., calling `->time()` on a TextColumn or generating a column that supports time formatting). If the downstream code that renders `$columnData` into a column definition only checks for `date`/`dateTime` keys, this new `time` entry will be silently ignored and the generated column won't format as a time.
